name: Darkshore Grouper
summary: Along Darkshore, Darkshore Grouper are a familiar catch, though murloc attacks have driven fishermen from their boats. The fish are prized for food and sport, and a good haul takes patience.

sections.title: A Staple of the Shrouded Coast
sections.body: In Darkshore’s cold waters, Darkshore Grouper are a welcome catch. Around Auberdine, anglers value them for the simple dishes they make. Travelers and residents alike enjoy those meals. A fishing line and basic gear are enough to bring one in. For many fishermen, catching a grouper is as pleasing as eating it.

sections.title: The Murloc Menace
sections.body: Fishermen such as Gubber Blump once rowed small boats into deeper waters and returned with grouper by the dozen. Now the coastal murlocs are more aggressive, and most boats around Auberdine stay ashore. Anglers fish from shore and dock instead. Locals suspect the murlocs are eating the grouper, so a good haul takes patience.

faq.q: Where can Darkshore Grouper be found?
faq.answer: Cast your line into Darkshore’s saltwater, including the waters around Auberdine, to catch Darkshore Grouper.

faq.q: Who wants Darkshore Grouper in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Gubber Blump, a dwarven fisherman staying in Auberdine, asks travelers to catch Darkshore Grouper for him. He offers a prized Blump Family Fishing Pole in return.

faq.q: Why aren't fishermen using boats to catch grouper?
faq.answer: Aggressive murlocs along Darkshore’s coast make boat trips too dangerous for local fishermen.

faq.q: Do you need to be on a quest to catch a Darkshore Grouper?
faq.answer: No. Darkshore Grouper are ordinary saltwater fish, and any angler can catch them in Darkshore’s waters. Locals such as Gubber Blump may ask you to catch them.

angles.text: Darkshore Grouper make a handy ingredient for simple coastal recipes. They give traveling cooks a way to practice their trade along the shore.
As a dwarf, you may recognize Gubber Blump. His fishing on Kalimdor’s shores carries on his family’s proud heritage. He rewards those who match his kin’s skill at catching fish.
